name: Cable Triceps Kickback
steps: Stand facing two low pulleys with feet hip-width apart and hold one handle in each hand.
Hinge forward with a flat back and draw your bent elbows up beside your ribs.
Straighten both elbows to press the handles behind you until your arms align with your torso.
Pause briefly at full extension, then bend your elbows to return the handles beneath your shoulders.
tips: Hold your upper arms still as your forearms move.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid swinging your torso to extend your arms.
